name: Looped Prediction Transformer: sharing one KV cache across loops cuts context memory up to 79% and improves perplexity
title: Looped Prediction Transformer: sharing one KV cache across loops cuts context memory up to 79% and improves perplexity
summary: Instead of a separate KV cache per loop, the first loop builds a shared cache and later loops keep only a small window of their own. Across 150M to 1B models it improves perplexity and accuracy; at 1B the hybrid has 10% lower perplexity than a standard Transformer, though at much higher inference compute.
